result:
Round 358 is done on my side and handed to C, with no STOP. I applied B's two patches exactly as given (their checksums matched) and updated doc 234. Nothing was committed or pushed.

**Changes** (on top of the round-357 tree, which I kept):
- **`StudioWorkspace.tsx`:**
  - The playback leaf now reacts only when play/stop actually changes.
  - The mount-time Follow update moved back to where HEAD had it, after the tempo-seed effect, and writes the status as plain text like HEAD did.
- **`follow-remount-ui.test.tsx`** (new): tests RM1 and RM2.
- **Doc 234:** status line now reads `In Progress (stage 1 of 3; C round 358 PASS)`, plus the C-R357-01 ruling, RM1/RM2 and the two new mutants, in Georgian.
- `git status` shows 57 entries. No protected, `perf/**`, `package.json` or root-lane files were touched.

**Checks run**
- **Claims before and after:** both match what B expected (the "after" run shows the 57 files, the new guard, mount effect and RM tests, and the effect order "tempo seed first").
- **RM1/RM2:** both failed before the source patch (RM1 got the extra "Tempo 90 BPM" sentence; RM2 got 2 status updates where 3 were expected) and pass after it.
- **Typecheck and lint:** both return 0, with 205 lint warnings (the limit is 205). Biome on my two code files passes.
- **Covering tests:** 71 files, 1290/1290 passed.
- **Mutants:** M-B1 to M-B4 fail exactly the same tests as on B's sketch (3, 2, 18 and 9). M-B5 and M-B6 make RM1 and RM2 fail. The store tree was unchanged afterwards and the scratch copy was removed.
- **Perf (production build):** 252 rows, 84/84 asserted rows pass, 0 new rows, 473 s. The only differences from C356 are the four play start/stop rows, which drop from 70 to 28 components re-rendered per Play/Stop, as predicted.
  - Caveat: the read-only code reviewer was running during part of this perf run. All counts came out exactly as predicted, so I kept the run; C's perf run is the one that counts.
- **Code review** (actual reviewer agent, whole diff): no Critical, High or Medium findings, and I changed no code after it.
  - It proposed two new Lows, which I logged for B and did not fix: RM1 should also check the update count, and no test pins exactly one status update per Stop while mounted.
  - Its architecture suggestion, extracting the Follow sync into its own hook later, is passed to B as a proposal only.

**Not done by me:**
- No browser rows; REMOUNT, PRE-REMOUNT, Follow and video sync are C's.
- No full test suite or `npm run verify`; those belong to the root gate.
- I didn't restart the :5173 dev server. If it serves stale cached modules after my builds, C should warm it up or restart it first.

The full report, with the exact next checks for C, is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-358.md`; logs and results are in `a-round-358/`.
